svg.title: Gatehouse Court — Double portcullis
svg.desc: Two gate towers flank a central portcullis. Walk below or cross the battlement; side doors keep the barracks and service court distinct. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
